title: Academic Writing Task 2: Research Funding and Public Priorities
prompt: In many countries, governments fund university research primarily through competitive grants awarded to individual scholars, while a smaller share supports long-term collaborative projects between universities and industry. Some people argue that competitive individual grants produce the most valuable knowledge, whereas others believe that sustained collaboration serves society better. Discuss both views and give your own opinion on which approach governments should prioritise when allocating public research funding. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先明确题目要求你讨论的两种观点：竞争性个人科研资助与长期校企合作资助，并说明你需要在讨论双方观点后给出自己的立场。写作时请分别解释两种资助方式的支持理由，可涉及创新效率、风险承担、成果转化与公共问责等角度，但避免只罗列优点。务必在文中清楚表明你支持哪一种资助优先顺序，并用具体理由和例子支撑。注意任务回应完整、论点展开充分、衔接自然、词汇与语法准确多样；字数不少于250词。
